description: External consultant who is not a mother-tongue speaker of the receptor language

name: External MTT consultant
description: External consultant who is a mother-tongue or near-mother-tongue speaker

name: Local advisor
description: Local expert (often mother-tongue) advises throughout; no external consultant in the standard sense

name: Unknown

name: Church minimal
